title: Full rescue line · Level 2
brief: Level 1's map of 300 mm tiles (a black line about 20 mm wide on white) with the record's elements added, laid by the simulator's map builder: level 1's 24 cells of 6 x 4 (the Start tile, two 150 mm gaps on straights, a T junction, a dead end, a crossing, round corners) with a fixed 150 mm cube on the straight below the second corner, then, past level 1's last gap, a straight with a speed bump (10 mm high), a 20 degree ramp up, a raised straight 109 mm up, a 20 degree ramp down, a corner, a straight with two pieces of debris (3 and 2 mm), and the Goal tile: 9.56 m of line. The robot is G6.3's (the robot file rescue-line-open, G8.4's: sensors 1 and 2 24 mm ahead, 16 mm each side, sensor 3 facing forward, sensor 4 on the centre line, a distance sensor ahead on I2C 5 and one at the side on I2C 7, the IMU on I2C 8, the arm and claw); a run on a changed robot is not this level's. It starts on the Start tile on the line, facing along it, moved up to 10 mm and turned up to 5 degrees (run 1 too). The RCJ referee judges: tiles reached in order (5.4.6), a lack of progress called when the robot passes the next tile's exit off the line (5.5.1b) or takes a wrong line (5.5.1c), then put back on the Start tile; going round the cube off the line is not a lack of progress. A run ends once the program has ended and the robot has then stood still for 0.5 s (both drive motors slower than 5 deg/s, the robot slower than 3 mm/s; the run's time is when that stillness began), after 3 lacks of progress, or after 240 s. The robot has stopped on the Goal when the run ended on that stillness with its axle's middle on the Goal tile. Score: 60 x the fraction of the line completed (the line through the tiles passed in order before the first lack of progress), + 20 x min(1, par / time) if it stopped on the Goal, + 20 if no lack of progress was called. Par 100 s (the record's). Pass: a mean of at least 60 over the 5 runs, and at least 4 of 5 stop on the Goal.

score.run: 60 * fraction + if(goal, 20 * min(1, par / goalTime), 0) + if(lops == 0, 20, 0)
score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)

pass: sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true) >= 60 & count(r in runs: r.goal) >= 0.8 * n
